text.text: Welcome, Alex. Your command center is live.
This channel is where *Veridian Health* plans, runs, and reviews every readiness test.

*How it works*
*1.* Build your admin team — share the load by module
*2.* Stand up the mandatory response teams
*3.* Review your threat map and pick a scenario
*4.* Trigger the test — everyone takes part right here

elements.text: Every step is a button — no commands to memorize.
